HLP-CONTEXT-1.question: Những việc làm nào cần Python?
HLP-CONTEXT-1.answer: I found 12 job postings that list Python.
HLP-CONTEXT-1.sql_text: SELECT id, title, company, location FROM clean_jobs WHERE tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%' ORDER BY id

HLP-CONTEXT-1.question: Chỉ những việc ở Hà Nội.
HLP-CONTEXT-1.answer: Among those, 7 Python job postings are in Hanoi.
HLP-CONTEXT-1.sql_text: SELECT id, title, company, location FROM clean_jobs WHERE tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%' AND location ILIKE '%Hanoi%' ORDER BY id

HON-CURRENCY-1.question: Việc làm nào có mức lương cao nhất?
HON-CURRENCY-1.answer: The highest-paid job in the database is the Data Scientist position at Sonat Game, with a maximum salary of 40,000,000 VND.
HON-CURRENCY-1.sql_text: SELECT id, title, company, role, tech_stack, location, source_url, job_level, listing_expires_on, created_on, is_internship, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, is_salary_negotiable FROM clean_jobs WHERE salary_max IS NOT NULL ORDER BY salary_max DESC LIMIT 1
